moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kick-Offs
moments.blurb: The Premier League continues with a packed weekend of fixtures, including Crystal Palace v Manchester City and Liverpool v Nottingham Forest on Friday and Saturday.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / The Guardian

angles.name: Weekend Warm-up
angles.copy: Who are you backing for the Premier League clashes this weekend? Crystal Palace host Man City Friday, then Saturday sees Liverpool, Spurs, and Chelsea all in action.

angles.name: London Derby Focus
angles.copy: Big London interest in the Premier League this weekend! Crystal Palace take on Manchester City Friday, while Chelsea face Brighton on Sunday. Any predictions?

angles.name: Man Utd vs Ipswich
angles.copy: Manchester United are at home to newly-promoted Ipswich on Sunday. Can United get back to winning ways after their opening weekend upset?

moments.title: Scottish Premiership Weekend
moments.blurb: The Scottish Premiership continues this weekend with Kilmarnock hosting Dundee United on Saturday, and a big Aberdeen v Rangers clash on Sunday.

source.l: SPFL Official Site / Live Football On TV

angles.name: Scottish Football Action
angles.copy: Another big weekend in the Scottish Premiership! Kilmarnock take on Dundee United Saturday, then Sunday sees Aberdeen host Rangers. Who's getting the points?

angles.name: Rangers Away Day
angles.copy: Rangers are on the road this Sunday, heading to Aberdeen for a 12:00 kick-off. Will they bring home the win?

moments.title: Happy 60th Shirley Manson
moments.blurb: Shirley Manson, the iconic Scottish lead singer of Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday today.

angles.name: Garbage Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage! What's your favourite track from the Scottish rock queen?

angles.name: Iconic Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 60th birthday to Shirley Manson! From Angelfish to Garbage, her voice has defined decades of alternative rock.

moments.title: Valerie Simpson turns 78
moments.blurb: Valerie Simpson, half of the legendary Motown songwriting and performing duo Ashford & Simpson, celebrates her 78th birthday today.

angles.name: Motown Legend
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to the incredible Valerie Simpson! Her work with Nick Ashford gave us some of Motown's most enduring classics. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Ashford & Simpson
angles.copy: Celebrating the fantastic Valerie Simpson, who turns 78 today! From 'Ain't No Mountain High Enough' to 'Solid', her legacy is undeniable.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK's August Bank Holiday weekend (England, Wales, Northern Ireland) begins, offering a three-day break for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: That's it, the August Bank Holiday weekend is officially here! What are your plans for the extra day off? Make it count!

angles.name: Welsh Bank Holiday
angles.copy: The Bank Holiday weekend is here! What are you getting up to across Wales this long weekend? Let us know!

angles.name: Devon Bank Holiday
angles.copy: It's the August Bank Holiday weekend, Devon! Whether you're hitting the beach or exploring the moors, enjoy your extra day off!

moments.title: Happy 56th Debbie Gibson
moments.blurb: 80s pop sensation Debbie Gibson, known for hits like 'Foolish Beat' and 'Lost in Your Eyes', celebrates her 56th birthday on Bank Holiday Monday.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 56th Birthday to the original teen pop idol, Debbie Gibson! What's your favourite of her chart-topping tunes?

angles.name: Electric Youth
angles.copy: It's Debbie Gibson's 56th birthday today! Still an 'Electric Youth' at heart, her music defined a generation. What's your go-to Debbie track?

moments.title: Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: The legendary Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison, famous for 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance', celebrates his 81st birthday on August 31st.

angles.name: Van The Man
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Van Morrison! From Belfast to global icon, his music is timeless. What's your favourite Van track?

angles.name: Musical Poet
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible songwriting and voice of Van Morrison, who turns 81 today! A true musical poet.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is set to return with its pre-recorded launch show on Saturday, September 19th, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly's Back!
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing returns with its launch show on September 19th. Excited for the new hosts and celebrity pairings?

angles.name: New Hosting Trio
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking over the Strictly hosting duties this year! What do you think of the new line-up ahead of the September 19th launch?

moments.title: F1 Italian Grand Prix
moments.blurb: Formula 1 heads to Monza for the Italian Grand Prix, taking place from September 4th-6th.

angles.name: Monza Madness
angles.copy: Next stop for Formula 1 is the iconic Monza! Who are you tipping for victory at the Italian Grand Prix this weekend?

angles.name: High-Speed Action
angles.copy: Get ready for some high-speed thrills! The Italian Grand Prix is just days away. Will we see any surprises at Monza?

moments.title: Queen Bey turns 45
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, the multi-Grammy award-winning singer, dancer, and actress, celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Queen Bey
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Wishing a phenomenal Happy 45th Birthday to the one and only Beyoncé! What's your ultimate Beyoncé anthem?

angles.name: Iconic Performer
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible talent and impact of Beyoncé, who turns 45 on Friday! From Destiny's Child to solo superstardom, she truly runs the world.

moments.title: Alex Lifeson turns 73
moments.blurb: Alex Lifeson, the legendary guitarist and co-founder of the Canadian progressive rock band Rush, celebrates his 73rd birthday tomorrow, August 27th.

angles.name: Rush Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 73rd Birthday to the incredible Alex Lifeson of Rush! His guitar work is simply legendary. What's your favourite Rush riff?

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Alex Lifeson, the guitar god from Rush, turns 73! Celebrate with us by cranking your favourite Rush track.

moments.title: Glen Matlock turns 70
moments.blurb: Glen Matlock, the original bassist and co-writer for the iconic punk band The Sex Pistols, celebrates his 70th birthday tomorrow, August 27th.

angles.name: Punk Rock Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 70th Birthday to punk rock legend Glen Matlock! The original Sex Pistol helped shape a movement. What's your favourite track from that era?

angles.name: Anarchy in the UK
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Glen Matlock, the man behind some of The Sex Pistols' most famous songs, turns 70! Still a punk rock icon.

moments.title: Scottish Rugby Premiership Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Arnold Clark Men's Premiership for Scottish Rugby kicks off this Saturday, August 29th, with five exciting fixtures.

angles.name: Rugby Season Begins
angles.copy: The Scottish Men's Premiership kicks off this Saturday! Get ready for an action-packed season of rugby across Scotland. Who are you supporting?

angles.name: Local Rugby Buzz
angles.copy: Big day for Scottish club rugby this Saturday as the Men's Premiership gets underway! Which match are you looking forward to?
